correctness.rationale: The geometric ten-line divisor has ten rational geometric components and fifteen ordinary nodes; its connected Picard torus has signed Petersen cycle character lattice. Seven exact 6x6 unimodular intertwiners from actual graph-action matrices and exhaustive S5 conjugacy classes prove integral decomposition for every Frobenius restriction. Standard finite-field torus descent gives all Weil restriction and norm-one factors and rational groups. The standalone proof checker was executed and ended with PETERSEN_SEVEN_INTEGRAL_TORUS_TYPES_OK; finite q examples are merely consistency checks.

value.rationale: The full ten-curve exceptional boundary is canonical, and its rank-six generalized-Jacobian torus is a meaningful arithmetic degeneration invariant. The complete seven-case integral classification distinguishes Weil restrictions and norm-one descent and supplies exact finite abelian groups not fixed by the published rational character, degree-two isogeny or surface Picard classification.
